# Generated by ppc finalize (arable_land_bar.py); do not edit by hand.
# Location scope, read only by the Arable Land bar of the location view: the land model in thousands of people
# (land = natural + improvements; use = farms + reserved grounds + subsistence peasants).

# Capacity multiplier as the engine applies it: (1 + local % + the owner's global %) x (1 + total %)
pp_land_bar_multiplier = {
	value = 1
	add = modifier:local_population_capacity_modifier
	if = { limit = { exists = owner } add = owner.modifier:global_population_capacity_modifier }
	multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:total_population_capacity_modifier }
	min = 0
}

# Natural land: flat capacity without the improvements and the housing, with the land the farms and reserved grounds take
pp_land_bar_natural_flat = {
	value = modifier:local_population_capacity
	subtract = pp_land_bar_improvements_flat
	subtract = pp_land_bar_housing_flat
	subtract = pp_land_bar_rank_housing_flat
	add = pp_land_bar_farms_flat
	add = pp_land_bar_reserved_flat
	min = 0
}

# In thousands of people (the capacity multiplier applied; subsistence peasants are people already)
pp_land_bar_natural = { value = pp_land_bar_natural_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_improvements = { value = pp_land_bar_improvements_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_room = { value = pp_land_bar_room_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_farms = { value = pp_land_bar_farms_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_reserved = { value = pp_land_bar_reserved_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_housing = {
	value = pp_land_bar_housing_flat
	add = pp_land_bar_rank_housing_flat
	multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier
}
pp_land_bar_subsistence = { value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:peasants)" }

pp_land_bar_land = { value = pp_land_bar_natural add = pp_land_bar_improvements }
pp_land_bar_max = { value = pp_land_bar_land add = pp_land_bar_room }
pp_land_bar_taken = { value = pp_land_bar_farms add = pp_land_bar_reserved }
pp_land_bar_used = { value = pp_land_bar_taken add = pp_land_bar_subsistence }
pp_land_bar_unused = { value = pp_land_bar_land subtract = pp_land_bar_used min = 0 }
pp_land_bar_overused = { value = pp_land_bar_used subtract = pp_land_bar_land min = 0 }
pp_land_bar_used_percent = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { pp_land_bar_land > 0 } value = pp_land_bar_used divide = pp_land_bar_land multiply = 100 }
}

# Bar fractions (0..1) on one scale for both rows: the larger of the maximum land and the land in use
pp_land_bar_scale = {
	value = pp_land_bar_max
	if = { limit = { pp_land_bar_used > pp_land_bar_max } value = pp_land_bar_used }
	min = 0.001
}
pp_land_bar_f_natural = { value = pp_land_bar_natural divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_land = { value = pp_land_bar_land divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_max = { value = pp_land_bar_max divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_farms = { value = pp_land_bar_farms divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_taken = { value = pp_land_bar_taken divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_used = { value = pp_land_bar_used divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_beyond = { value = 1 subtract = pp_land_bar_f_land min = 0 }

# Land the standing improvements add (raw_modifier capacity per level)

# Housing of the town ranks (rank_modifier capacity, vanilla plus the mod's injects)
pp_land_bar_rank_housing_flat = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city } value = 25 }
	else_if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis } value = 40 }
	else_if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town } value = 10 }
}

# Room for improvements: per cap, the land its improvements could still add
pp_land_bar_room_flat = {
	value = 0
	add = pp_land_bar_room_field_management_shared
	add = pp_land_bar_room_irrigated_fields_terms
	add = pp_land_bar_room_land_clearance_terms
	add = pp_land_bar_room_paddy_water_control_shared

	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:bund } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:bund)" }

	min = 0
	multiply = pp_land_bar_room_water_control_shared_land
}
pp_land_bar_room_water_control_shared_land = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 7.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { dominant_culture ?= culture:khmer_culture OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 7.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } OR = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp } AND = { OR = { climate = continental climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental climate = oceanic climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic climate = mediterranean climate = subtropical climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon climate = tropical climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_savanna climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { topography = flatland topography = ha1300_topo_valleys topography = hills } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { OR = { topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } OR = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp } AND = { OR = { climate = continental climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental climate = oceanic climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic climate = mediterranean climate = subtropical climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon climate = tropical climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_savanna climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { topography = flatland topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_valleys topography = hills topography = ha1300_topo_rolling topography = plateau } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = hills topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } } OR = { topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { OR = { climate = arid climate = cold_arid } has_river = no NOT = { is_adjacent_to_lake = yes } } AND = { OR = { climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { vegetation = desert vegetation = ha1300_veg_scrubland vegetation = sparse } has_river = no NOT = { is_adjacent_to_lake = yes } } } } value = 5 }
